associate_contact_to_company.description: Connect a HubSpot contact to a company so they show up together in your CRM.
associate_contact_to_company.display_name: Link a contact to a company
associate_contact_to_company.name: associate_contact_to_company

create_company.description: Create a new HubSpot company record. HubSpot de-duplicates companies on the domain.
create_company.name: create_company

create_contact.description: Create a new contact with email, name, phone, and company details. HubSpot de-duplicates contacts on the email address.
create_contact.name: create_contact

parameters.description: The HubSpot user who owns this contact.
parameters.name: owner_id

create_deal.description: Create a new deal, optionally in a chosen pipeline and stage. An account with one pipeline uses its default when none is chosen.
create_deal.name: create_deal

parameters.description: The pipeline the deal belongs to. Leave empty to use the account's default pipeline.
parameters.name: pipeline

parameters.description: The stage the deal starts in. Leave empty to use the first stage of its pipeline; HubSpot itself would otherwise create the deal with no stage at all.
parameters.name: stage

parameters.description: The HubSpot user who owns this deal.
parameters.name: owner_id

create_note.description: Log a note on the timeline of a contact, company and/or deal. A note attached to no record is valid but will not appear anywhere in HubSpot, so name at least one.

properties.hs_note_body: Left a voicemail about the renewal.

create_note.name: create_note

parameters.description: Contact to attach the note to.
parameters.name: contact_id

parameters.description: Company to attach the note to.
parameters.name: company_id

parameters.description: Deal to attach the note to.
parameters.name: deal_id

parameters.description: Where the note sits on the record timeline. Defaults to now.
parameters.name: noted_at

create_task.description: Create a task with a due date, optionally attached to a contact, company and/or deal.

properties.hs_task_body: Confirm the seat count before sending.
properties.hs_task_subject: Follow up on the renewal quote

create_task.name: create_task

parameters.description: Whether the task is already done.
parameters.name: status

parameters.description: What kind of task this is.
parameters.name: task_type

parameters.description: The HubSpot user the task is assigned to.
parameters.name: owner_id

parameters.description: Contact to attach the task to.
parameters.name: contact_id

parameters.description: Company to attach the task to.
parameters.name: company_id

parameters.description: Deal to attach the task to.
parameters.name: deal_id

delete_company.description: Archive a HubSpot company. HubSpot archives rather than destroys: the record leaves the CRM and the API, and stays restorable from the portal's recycling bin for 90 days.
delete_company.name: delete_company

parameters.description: HubSpot company ID, or the address of the company record in HubSpot.
parameters.name: company_id

delete_contact.description: Archive a HubSpot contact. HubSpot archives rather than destroys: the record leaves the CRM and the API, and stays restorable from the portal's recycling bin for 90 days.
delete_contact.name: delete_contact

parameters.description: HubSpot contact ID, or the address of the contact record in HubSpot.
parameters.name: contact_id

delete_deal.description: Archive a HubSpot deal. HubSpot archives rather than destroys: the record leaves the CRM and the API, and stays restorable from the portal's recycling bin for 90 days.
delete_deal.name: delete_deal

parameters.description: HubSpot deal ID, or the address of the deal record in HubSpot.
parameters.name: deal_id

delete_note.description: Archive a HubSpot note. HubSpot archives rather than destroys: the record leaves the CRM and the API, and stays restorable from the portal's recycling bin for 90 days.
delete_note.name: delete_note

delete_task.description: Archive a HubSpot task. HubSpot archives rather than destroys: the record leaves the CRM and the API, and stays restorable from the portal's recycling bin for 90 days.
delete_task.name: delete_task

get_company.description: Read one HubSpot company by its record ID.
get_company.name: get_company

parameters.description: HubSpot company ID, or the address of the company record in HubSpot.
parameters.name: company_id

get_contact_by_email.description: Look up a HubSpot contact using an email address. Fails the step when no contact has that address.
get_contact_by_email.name: get_contact_by_email

get_deal.description: Read one HubSpot deal by its record ID.
get_deal.name: get_deal

parameters.description: HubSpot deal ID, or the address of the deal record in HubSpot.
parameters.name: deal_id

list_contacts.description: List a page of HubSpot contacts for quick review. These come back in record-id order (oldest first) and cannot be filtered; use 'Find contacts created in a date range' to report on recent leads.
list_contacts.name: list_contacts

parameters.description: How many contacts to return (default 10, maximum 100).
parameters.name: limit

list_deals.description: List a page of HubSpot deals, in record-id order (oldest first).
list_deals.name: list_deals

parameters.description: How many deals to return (default 10, maximum 100).
parameters.name: limit

search_contacts.description: Find HubSpot contacts created on or after a date, newest first. Returns the matching contacts plus the total number that match, so a report can count every new lead in the window.
search_contacts.display_name: Find contacts created in a date range
search_contacts.name: search_contacts

parameters.description: Only return contacts created at or after this moment.
parameters.name: created_after

parameters.description: Optional upper bound, exclusive. Leave empty to run the window up to now.
parameters.name: created_before

parameters.description: How many contacts to return, newest first (default 100, maximum 2000). The total count is reported in full even when more contacts match than are returned.
parameters.name: limit

update_company.description: Change the details of an existing HubSpot company, such as its name, domain, or industry.
update_company.name: update_company

parameters.description: HubSpot company ID, or the address of the company record in HubSpot.
parameters.name: company_id

update_contact.description: Change the details of an existing HubSpot contact, such as their name, phone number, or company.
update_contact.name: update_contact

parameters.description: HubSpot contact ID, or the address of the contact record in HubSpot.
parameters.name: contact_id

update_deal_stage.description: Move a HubSpot deal to a different stage of its pipeline.
update_deal_stage.name: update_deal_stage

parameters.description: HubSpot deal ID, or the address of the deal record in HubSpot.
parameters.name: deal_id

parameters.description: The stage to move the deal to.
parameters.name: stage

description: Automate HubSpot CRM: manage contacts, companies, deals, notes and tasks with a HubSpot service key.
